name: Plantland Nursery & Orchards
description: Plantland Nursery & Orchards is an independent orchard in Ocala, FL. It grows Pears, Peaches, Persimmons, Grapes, and Peas, with picking through autumn, summer, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Oct in this growing zone.
